name: @kuraa/desktop
description: Edit folders of Pandoc markdown and R Markdown files, alone or live with others.
author: kuraa

scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && node scripts/fetch-git.mjs mac-arm64 mac-x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/fetch-git.mjs win-x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && node scripts/fetch-git.mjs linux-x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux
